title: Duckling eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2a3a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='66' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f5b81f'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='66' rx='11' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#ffd94d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 60 Q80 54 76 66 Q72 72 66 70 Z' fill='#ffd93b' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='16' fill='#ffd93b' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head tuft -->
  <path d='M38 21 Q36 14 42 16 Q46 14 44 21' fill='#ffe14f' stroke='#fff1a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='34' r='3.6' fill='#3a2a0a'/>
  <circle cx='36.2' cy='32.8' r='1.2' fill='#fffde0'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ff9a6b' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- open beak (eating) -->
  <path d='M20 34 Q10 32 12 40 Q16 44 20 42 Z' fill='#ff9a2e' stroke='#ffc46b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M20 42 Q10 46 12 52 Q16 54 20 50 Z' fill='#f07818' stroke='#ffb04a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- snack: bread chunk in beak -->
  <path d='M14 41 Q8 39 6 44 Q7 50 13 49 Q17 47 16 43 Z' fill='#c98a3c' stroke='#e8b366' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='43' r='1' fill='#a86a24'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='45' r='0.9' fill='#a86a24'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='9' cy='53' r='1.4' fill='#e8b366'/>
  <circle cx='6' cy='49' r='1' fill='#e8b366'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40 84 L33 88 L40 87 L44 89 Z' fill='#ff9a2e' stroke='#ffc46b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M54 84 L47 88 L54 87 L58 89 Z' fill='#ff9a2e' stroke='#ffc46b' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
